title: ConfigFact
description: A fact produced by a CaptureRecipe, mapping recipe output to a question_id answer with captured provenance. FCA guardrail: answer 'yes' means the condition was probed and confirmed; 'no' means probed and denied; absence of a fact means the section was absent from the recipe output and must never be treated as confirmation.

question_id.description: Question ID from the interview question graph (e.g. 'iam-001')

answer.description: Captured answer. Only 'yes' or 'no' — unknown/unsure must not be emitted; use fact absence instead.
